h1: Zhong Sheng Ji Scam Warning: 5 Practical Checks Before You Pay

sections.h2: Common Zhong Sheng Ji Scam Signals

items.content: The public contact for this site is Mr. Liang Dongrong via WeChat NSDG521 and liangdongrong@gmail.com. Pause if someone uses the team name while changing the contact or payment account without confirmation through the published channel.
The selected plan, schedule, materials, main steps, video record, return items and follow-up should be explained before payment. Promotional claims are not a substitute for a clear service scope.

items.h3: Low Initial Price Followed by Repeated Charges
items.content: Confirm the total RMB price, RMB 10,000 deposit, balance, upgrade difference, rescheduling and refund terms. Unexplained charges for emergency, extra empowerment or guaranteed effects are warning signs.
Contact Mr. Liang through WeChat NSDG521 or liangdongrong@gmail.com and reconfirm the selected plan and payment arrangement before sending funds.
Confirm who coordinates the service, where it is carried out, whether travel to Taiwan is required, the expected schedule, service term and plot arrangement.
Confirm the recording scope, video delivery, return items and follow-up contact. A video can show recorded steps but cannot guarantee the same outcome for every client.

Before sending hair, nail clippings, clothing or other personal materials, confirm the recipient, address, purpose, retention and handling after completion. Ask about non-invasive alternatives for any biological sample.

The current published plans are RMB 72,000 and RMB 500,000, with an RMB 10,000 booking deposit. Confirm the balance, upgrade difference, third-party costs, rescheduling, cancellation, refund and full delivery.
Return to the published WeChat ID or email if anyone changes the contact, payment account or plan.
Confirm the service, payment stages, schedule, delivery, personal-material handling, rescheduling and refund terms, and keep payment and communication records.

items.h3: Reject Guaranteed Outcomes and Fear-Based Pressure
items.content: No health, wealth, career, marriage, fertility or fortune result is guaranteed. Stop if anyone claims immediate payment is required to prevent harm or demands extra fees to remove a threat.
